$comment: Evidence map for Phase 33. This probes the universal reality kernel and purity boundary; live database execution and operational observation remain declared.

areas.area: Universal kernel SQL and typed contracts remain coherent
areas.requirement: Classifications, observation kinds, event states and relationship constraints are represented consistently in the migration and TypeScript contracts.

evidence.contains: universal reality substrate
registers every classification value present in the migration CHECK clause
registers every observation kind present in the migration CHECK clause
mirrors the relationship constraints

areas.area: Reality, observation, evidence and derived values remain distinguishable
areas.requirement: Invalid classifications/kinds/states/confidence/payloads and self-relationships are rejected; observations do not collapse into verified truth.

evidence.contains: accepts only registered classifications, kinds, and states
bounds confidence to [0, 1]
builds a truth-hierarchy observation draft with no collapsed kind
rejects self-relationships

areas.area: Universal reality drafts preserve tenant, temporal and provenance fields
areas.requirement: Entity, relationship, event and observation drafts normalize scope and reject invalid required fields while preserving event idempotency and observation evidence references.

evidence.contains: builds a valid entity draft with defaults
builds a versioned event draft with pending delivery state
builds a valid relationship draft between distinct entities
rejects invalid observation drafts

areas.area: The kernel contains only universal primitives
areas.requirement: Kernel sources contain no Scholar/domain vocabulary, legacy domain-table references or runtime-named helpers, and consumer references remain opaque.

evidence.contains: contains no domain vocabulary in any kernel source
never references legacy domain tables
records consumption by opaque reference
exposes a generic consumer query instead of a runtime-named helper

areas.area: Domain runtimes install over the kernel without reverse coupling
areas.requirement: Runtime consumption remains in the runtime layer, Scholar runtime modules consume kernel contracts, and kernel modules never import runtime modules.

evidence.contains: keeps runtime consumption in the runtime layer
keeps the dependency arrow one-way
runtime

areas.area: The universal kernel database boundary is deny-by-default
areas.requirement: Kernel tables enable RLS, revoke broad client grants, and avoid implicit authenticated/anonymous access.

evidence.contains: is deny-by-default at the database boundary
registers every classification value present in the migration CHECK clause

areas.area: Live reality persistence, observations and runtime operations are wired
areas.requirement: Kernel tables, RLS policies, runtime registration, observation writes, provenance and operational health are executed against an approved live database boundary.

evidence.contains: provenance
